links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

results.description: List of returned documents that MongoDB Cloud provides when completing this request.

totalCount.description: Total number of documents available. MongoDB Cloud omits this value if `includeCount` is set to `false`. The total number is an estimate and may not be exact.

amountBilledCents.description: Sum of services that the specified organization consumed in the period covered in this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in cents (100ths of one US Dollar).

amountPaidCents.description: Sum that the specified organization paid toward this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in cents (100ths of one US Dollar).

created.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud created this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

creditsCents.description: Sum that MongoDB credited the specified organization toward this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in cents (100ths of one US Dollar).

endDate.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud finished the billing period that this invoice covers. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the invoice submitted to the specified organization. Charges typically post the next day.

linkedInvoices.description: List that contains the invoices for organizations linked to the paying organization.

links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

orgId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization charged for services consumed from MongoDB Cloud.

salesTaxCents.description: Sum of sales tax applied to this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in cents (100ths of one US Dollar).

startDate.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud began the billing period that this invoice covers. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

startingBalanceCents.description: Sum that the specified organization owed to MongoDB when MongoDB issued this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in US Dollars.

statusName.description:
Phase of payment processing in which this invoice exists when you made this request. Accepted phases include:

- `CLOSED`: MongoDB finalized all charges in the billing cycle but has yet to charge the customer.
- `FAILED`: MongoDB attempted to charge the provided credit card but charge for that amount failed.
- `FORGIVEN`: Customer initiated payment which MongoDB later forgave.
- `FREE`: All charges totalled zero so the customer won't be charged.
- `INVOICED`: MongoDB handled these charges using elastic invoicing.
- `PAID`: MongoDB succeeded in charging the provided credit card.
- `PENDING`: Invoice includes charges for the current billing cycle.
- `PREPAID`: Customer has a pre-paid plan so they won't be charged.

subtotalCents.description: Sum of all positive invoice line items contained in this invoice. This parameter expresses its value in cents (100ths of one US Dollar).

updated.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud last updated the value of this payment. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

href.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points another API resource to which this response has some relationship. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

rel.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that defines the semantic relationship between this resource and another API resource. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.
